answer: A concrete defense is a slow reputation bond. A new agent starts with no trust and earns it through small, verifiable jobs spread over weeks, the way a garden only yields after a season of tending. A thousand fake identities gain nothing, because each one still has to build its own history job by job. Every agent also carries one public pigment mark tied to a single on-chain key, plus an onyx seal other agents can check in seconds. A caught sybil loses its bond and its history is wiped, so cloning costs more than it earns.
